name: Security Watch agent (W3) — 8-case golden set (decision-band + edge spread)
description: Phase 4 skeleton golden set per security_watch.spec.md §7. Covers the 5 decision tiers (log_only / warn / page_oncall / quarantine_tenant / disable_workspace) across the major threat kinds + the four spec §8 edge cases (demo window, cross-tenant pattern, already quarantined, partner allowlisted, recursive injection). Full 80-case set lands in tests/golden/security_watch/*.json during Phase 5 per spec §7. Latency budget: median TTR ≤ 90 sec from signal arrival to action; false_quarantine_rate ≤ 0.001; missed_critical_rate = 0.
